decisions.reason: The multi-model enclosed laser workstation line builds on the firm's core laser competence and is only two years old, so management still sees invested resources and ramp-up explanations as reasons to persist.
The thermal inkjet printer has a dedicated page and fits the announced single-source, surface-matched portfolio, so the visible commitment and the need to justify the launch favor keeping it.
The in-house developed piezo inkjet printer is publicly featured and central to the technology-matching strategy, so sunk development costs weigh in favor of continuing it.
As the home-page flagship laser line tied to the firm's announced direction, it carries the strongest public and strategic commitment and will almost certainly be retained.
The LC400 laser cabin was launched in 2024 with its own page and complements the laser focus, so it is far too early and too visible to drop.
The award-winning HR-Lube system has external validation and builds on established inkjet competence, giving management strong justification to keep investing in it.
